rules.DG001: Display text uses solid, readable ink rather than clipped decorative fills.
rules.DG002: Authored work surfaces are opaque; backdrop blur belongs only to overlays.
rules.DG003: No bouncing or pinging idle decorations.
rules.DG004: Product videos start paused and offer explicit playback controls.
rules.DG005: Use literal agent labels or a bot icon instead of a magic/sparkle metaphor.
rules.DG006: Elevation uses the shared scale; no per-screen arbitrary shadows.
rules.DG007: A native link cannot contain a button and a button cannot contain a link.
rules.DG008: Canonical tokens must generate the checked-in CSS exactly.
rules.DG009: Semantic text and essential control edges meet the configured contrast thresholds.
